priorStories.headline: Orange County fire forces 16,000 to evacuate
priorStories.body:
The Norte Fire spread to 570 acres near San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano and was 0% contained as of 7:28 p.m. Pacific time Friday.

At least six homes burned, about 16,000 residents were ordered to evacuate and two firefighters were hospitalized with heat-related injuries. Evacuation orders covered five zones.

priorStories.headline: Aerial attacks disrupt power and Russian flights
priorStories.body:
Russian attacks struck nine Ukrainian regions overnight, wounding at least 15 people and cutting electricity to hundreds of thousands of households, according to Ukrainian officials.

Russia’s Defense Ministry said its forces intercepted 644 Ukrainian drones. Airport restrictions delayed more than 200 flights from four Moscow airports; 46 flights were delayed or canceled in St. Petersburg.

candidates.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters of Ukraine to defend a new U.S. sanctions package targeting Russia after President Donald Trump put the restrictions on hold. Zelenskyy said blocking the package would encourage further Russian attacks and thanked the Democratic and Republican lawmakers who backed it.
candidates.title: Zelenskyy urges support for paused US sanctions on Russia

candidates.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was unlikely to visit Budapest later in October. A Zelenskyy aide had said Ukraine's leader was invited to join events on October 23 commemorating the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian Revolution.
candidates.title: Hungarian prime minister says Zelenskyy visit is unlikely

candidates.summary: Authorities said at least 17 people were killed and 25 injured in a crowd crush at a Durga Puja pavilion in north Kolkata. Police attributed the incident to heavy crowds amid rainfall; West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said a seven-year-old girl was among those killed.
candidates.title: Crowd crush at Kolkata religious festival kills at least 17

sources.name: Al Jazeera, with AFP and Reuters

candidates.summary: Pope Leo XIV returned to the Vatican four days after surgery that removed the cancerous lower lobe of his right lung. His surgeon said he expected a full recovery and saw no clinical reason to prevent the pope's planned November trip to Uruguay, Peru and Argentina.
candidates.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery

sources.name: United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

candidates.summary: France's interior minister said about 550,000 people joined 110 marches over living costs and school conditions, while organizers estimated 800,000. Authorities reported about 400 arrests after clashes, fires and looting in several cities. An investigation was opened after a protester in Saint-Etienne lost a hand.
candidates.title: Nationwide French protests draw hundreds of thousands

candidates.summary: Masked people described by Belgian officials as Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters and a visiting delegation near Taybeh in the occupied West Bank. The delegation included Belgian, French and Polish diplomats and Catholic representatives. A French mayor said he was beaten, and a Belgian diplomatic vehicle was damaged. Israeli police opened an investigation.
candidates.title: European diplomatic delegation attacked in occupied West Bank

candidates.summary: Authorities in Sanaa unilaterally released 159 people recently detained in connection with Yemen's conflict, with support from the International Committee of the Red Cross. The ICRC said it interviewed and medically assessed the detainees but did not determine who or how many people would be freed. The release was outside the Stockholm Agreement framework.
candidates.title: Sanaa authorities release 159 conflict-related detainees

sources.name: International Committee of the Red Cross

candidates.summary: Rallies organized by the No Kings network took place in cities and communities across the United States, including Washington, New York and Atlanta. Organizers opposing President Donald Trump focused the demonstrations on encouraging early voting before the November 3 midterm elections.
candidates.title: No Kings rallies promote early voting across US

candidates.summary: A march in Milan against wars and rising living costs began peacefully before masked participants clashed with police, looted stores and set property and barricades on fire. Police used tear gas and water cannons. LaPresse reported that at least two officers were injured and about 50 demonstrators, many of them minors, were detained.
candidates.title: Milan protest ends in clashes, looting and fires

candidates.summary: President Donald Trump held a campaign rally at Truist Arena in Highland Heights, Kentucky, to support Republican candidates and encourage turnout before the midterm elections. Trump said his second term was more powerful than his first while promoting candidates including U.S. House hopeful Ed Gallrein.
candidates.title: Trump campaigns for Republican candidates in Kentucky

candidates.summary: Officials said the death toll from the crowd crush at a Durga Puja pavilion rose to at least 19, with 25 people injured. The crush occurred Saturday night as people near the north Kolkata pavilion sought cover during rainfall.
candidates.title: Death toll in Kolkata religious festival crowd crush rises to 19

candidates.summary: A truck drove through a youth soccer game at Wichita's Stryker Sports Complex, killing a six-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man and sending 11 other people to hospitals. Police detained the 34-year-old driver but said they were still investigating how and why the incident occurred.
candidates.title: Truck drives through Kansas youth soccer game, killing two

candidates.summary: Canada's defence minister said an incident at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright caused deaths and injuries and a major fire. Officials did not immediately disclose casualty figures or the cause. High winds carried the fire beyond the base fence, prompting a multi-jurisdiction emergency response, but no evacuation order was in effect.
candidates.title: Deaths and injuries reported after fire at Canadian military base

candidates.summary: Romania's Defence Ministry said Romanian F-16s shot down two jet-powered Geran attack drones after they entered national airspace over Romanian territorial waters. The ministry said the drones were downed southeast and east of Sulina after spending two and five minutes, respectively, in Romanian airspace.
candidates.title: Romanian F-16s shoot down two attack drones over territorial waters

candidates.summary: The U.S. National Hurricane Center said Hurricane Trudy was affecting portions of west-central Mexico as a Category 2 storm with maximum sustained winds of 100 mph. Hurricane warnings covered the coast from Manzanillo to Cabo Corrientes, and the center warned of dangerous storm surge, damaging waves, flooding and mudslides.
candidates.title: Hurricane Trudy affects Mexico's Pacific coast as Category 2 storm
